name: train_spec_riven
description: Dispatch marker for the Riven specialist (riftlab.yml, request=lab/specs/train_spec_riven.json, chain=N iterations): a net of its own, started from the general net, trained on its own decisions with Riven against the jury of loop.SPECIALISTS['riven'] (piloted by the general net or by that legend's specialist), adopted when it beats its previous version in the Riven mirror (55% or SPRT) without doing worse against the jury (paired, 3 points). Ladder: lab/learn/specialists/riven/ladder.json; nets lab/learn/nets/spec_riven_*.
